subject: Important Information Regarding Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, We are writing to inform you that there has been a change in our account policies. Starting next month, there will be a slight adjustment to the fees associated with your account. We understand the importance of transparency in financial matters and want to ensure you are aware of these changes well in advance. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your continued trust and partnership.
